headline: Enphase IQ Battery and Microinverters
summary: Homeowners who prioritize modularity and per-panel optimization often prefer Enphase. Microinverters under each panel behave differently from a single string inverter plus DC optimizer design.

product_lines.name: IQ8 Series Microinverters
product_lines.notes: Per-panel conversion; shading on one module impacts that module primarily.

product_lines.name: IQ Battery 5P
product_lines.notes: Modular ~5 kWh class AC-coupled battery; stack multiple units for larger backup. Confirm datasheet for cycle/retention guarantees.

questions_to_ask_installer: How many battery modules are needed for whole-home vs essential loads?
Is the system controller / gateway included for backup transfer?
red_flags: Enphase battery quoted with an unrelated string inverter ecosystem without explaining communication/backup limitations.

sections.heading: Modular batteries vs one big box
sections.body: Enphase’s modular batteries trade a larger wall footprint for incremental capacity and a long warranty narrative. Compare apples-to-apples kWh, backup loads, and labor — not module count alone.

faqs.question: Why is one IQ battery smaller than a Powerwall?
faqs.answer: Enphase uses smaller modules you stack. Three ~5 kWh units approximate one large ~15 kWh pack — quotes should show total kWh, not unit count only.
